## Agent workpad

### UNSUCCESSFUL integration audit — coordinator prerequisite split required

Base and freshly fetched main: `1df9b65e95b2976ef9eeb3e46b66877580e2e20c`. Local clean audit candidate: `ff4d0d455209c6a3dda2907e011cb25c52b1cc43`, branch `agent/issue-24`. No production code, test, expectation, source pin, manifest, CI or workflow changed. No PR/push/merge or completed-delivery claim. The current-main 129-task manifest/source/ledger/gates validate. Parent/task controls were active throughout the audit.

**Concrete blocker:** the initial full-pool XMage normal-reset replay contract required by this issue is missing. [OpeningCountsTest](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/1df9b65e95b2976ef9eeb3e46b66877580e2e20c/references/xmage/OpeningCountsTest.java) explicitly injects seven-card hands and 33 identical basic cards per library, disables initial shuffling, makes shuffleLibrary a no-op, and picks the first hand UUID for bottoming. It exports counts and stops at first upkeep. Its [runner](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/1df9b65e95b2976ef9eeb3e46b66877580e2e20c/scripts/opening_reference.py) accurately excludes initial shuffle, identity/order and full-game comparison. [NeutralSmokeTest](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/1df9b65e95b2976ef9eeb3e46b66877580e2e20c/references/xmage/NeutralSmokeTest.java) only consumes a one-pass synthetic fixture and rejects mulligans. [InstantResponseTest](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/1df9b65e95b2976ef9eeb3e46b66877580e2e20c/references/xmage/InstantResponseTest.java) also rejects mulligans. All four child pack reports explicitly limit their receipts to synthetic reference positions.

A red/green 40-card opening with two physical copies, an explicit mulligan permutation and a particular ordered bottom choice cannot be represented/observed by that count-only bridge. Swapping the duplicate identities or omitting/adding a chance event can preserve counts; required GR-010/011/012 and GR-020/021/022 controls need occurrence-aware inputs and checkpoints. This is source evidence of an absent required bridge, **not a compiled behavioral-red test, live XMage failure or newly alleged defect in the earlier count-only delivery**. Native complete games cannot substitute for this reference contract.

**Prerequisites verified:** #23/#209/#210/#211/#212/#213 are all closed completed. Their workpads preserve acceptance and independent review; all six protected PRs and successful exact-main push CI were independently re-fetched. PR/run pairs: [#266](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/pull/266) / [38004003811](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/actions/runs/38004003811); [#247](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/pull/247) / [37917675455](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/actions/runs/37917675455); [#264](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/pull/264) / [37983551530](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/actions/runs/37983551530); [#246](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/pull/246) / [37913917467](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/actions/runs/37913917467); [#265](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/pull/265) / [38000848472](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/actions/runs/38000848472); [#249](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/pull/249) / [37924924294](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/actions/runs/37924924294).

**Acceptance accounting:** R0002-B010 retains frozen decks/twenty cards/token and the completed mechanics audit, but no full-deck normal-reset reference claim. B011 retains scoped native/rules evidence and pin limitations, without a fresh vintage certification. B026 retains all twelve families: bounded reference evidence for priority, costs, targets, triggers, combat, continuous changes, objects and terminal outcomes; native decision/privacy/pending-replay evidence; required setup/reference identity and order remains missing. Batch/worker extensions remain deferred by current scope. B028 retains actual out-of-process child XMage receipts, named intermediate fields and rejection boundaries, upstream provenance and explicit unsupported observations; it fails the initial normal-reset strict chance/identity path. B030 retains ordinary discovery, independent expectations, four pack holdouts and twelve named compiled mutation detections. Forge/dual qualification and new AI-corpus stages retain their existing owners; no work is silently moved to GH-24 or waived.

The preserved inventory enumerates all **175 unchanged M2 catalog rows** (56/50/38/31) with original owners/expectations, child mappings/boundaries and receipt hashes. Catalog allocations and repeated invocations are not distinct scenario counts. The >=100 individually reviewed scenario/family admission and final per-capability planned/executed/agreed/disputed/unsupported aggregate remain outstanding; this audit does **not** establish that fewer than 100 suitable scenarios exist. Synthetic and raw-rejection/domain limits must stay visible when the audit resumes.

**Proposed coordinator split; no tasks registered here:**
1. Occurrence-preserving XMage opening transcript: exact frozen multisets, physical occurrence IDs, strict initial/mulligan permutations, real opening draws and London declaration/redraw/ordered-bottom chronology, both starters, 0/1/multiple mulligans including both players; literal identity/order checkpoints and wrong/missing/extra chance/choice controls. Preserve count regressions.
2. Continuous full-pool transcript/checkpoint integration after that opening contract: strict existing mechanic choices, physical/incarnation/token/stack identity through zone changes, all required intermediate fields, actual consumed choices, no default callbacks. Split further by actual bridge interfaces if source inspection shows it exceeds one independently testable change.
3. Initial native/XMage normal-reset game admission after the controller: reviewed rules-terminal games across required matchup rows, exact tapes/checkpoints, deterministic repeats and negative controls. Coordinator must reconcile quota/ownership with current requirements, preserving later dual/AI-corpus obligations.
Then resume this original audit and complete distinct-scenario and capability admission. Broad bridge implementation exceeds the explicitly bounded audit scope. No RFC 0003 implementation or new RL work.

**Preserved local evidence:** `doc/evidence/m2-coverage-audit/{README.md,catalog-inventory.json,dependencies.json,source-hashes.json}` in the above commit. Inventory SHA-256 `0ed4a3255cd3f8993d6a96e6f065d0ae5a8799b71dfc415edfe8d2ef388fe3ec`. README impact: no usable command, setup, behavior, architecture or verified milestone delivered; root already keeps M2 incomplete, so no root change. Documentation links, catalog identity/hash checks, manifest validation and diff checks pass.

Prescribed separate read-only diagnostic review **PASS**, zero findings, exact head/base above. It checked all mappings/hashes, retained expectations, README accuracy and atomic ownership; it did not re-run heavy tests or GitHub receipts. Initial app-server initialization EROFS failed, then narrow approved retry retained read-only reviewer mode and passed. This review validates the documentation candidate, not full issue acceptance.

**Full baseline PASS:** required `./scripts/torture.sh` (including verify) under the existing shared heavy lock, exit 0: **263 Python tests and 1,420 Rust debug/release executions, zero failed/ignored Rust tests**. Raw log `.agent-artifacts/gh24-torture.log`, SHA-256 `f25d86814a9a3d61f7b52ebad66c9b842674fb7236d93dcbe163617982b4dcaa`. Initial shared-lock EROFS was resolved by narrowly approved execution using the unchanged lock; no alternate lock or skipped gate. Fresh main remains unchanged and candidate is clean. No fresh external-reference execution claimed; a native baseline pass cannot satisfy the missing bridge. Approximately 20 minutes elapsed, including full verification and review.

**Failed-task handoff COMPLETE** under the existing shared handoff lock: refreshed unchanged main, all 129 registered task states, parent/current controls and all ready/running claims. Parent Program workpad upsert read back exactly, preserving all other entries. No eligible independent successor: #25 blocked, #26 depends on unsuccessful #24 and unfinished #25; other authorized tasks closed. Other claims [] preserved. M3–M5 remain deferred; #241 not dispatched. This unsuccessful issue satisfies no dependency. Preserve local branch/evidence for coordinator repair registration and explicit reactivation; issue stays open. Blocking/removal of running/ready follows as the final tracker operation.
